login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Reach your portfolio, or run the fund.
login.pitchTitle: A « comptoir » is the trading post one opens far from home to do business there.
login.pitchBody: Yours holds your investment vehicles country by country: each keeps its own currency, company number and local law. Four movements, and they always reconcile: what the investor pledged, what was called, what reached the account, and what was paid back. Built for the globetrotting investor.
login.askAccessHelp: Choose your plan: a confirmation e-mail is sent to you, then your account opens and your access reaches you. A management company running several vehicles receives a quote.
login.forgotHelp: Give your account's address: a link to choose a new password will be sent there.
login.forgotEmailHint: The one you sign in with.
login.missing: Give your e-mail address and your password.

errors.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.network: The fund's server is not answering.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: The fund's cash, the debt it already carries, and what is waiting on a decision.
dashboard.cashHint: What the bank would say: contributions less deployments, plus returns, less distributions.
dashboard.owedHint: Interest accrued, and the principal once it falls due.
dashboard.freeHint: What is left once the debt is covered.
dashboard.freeNegative: The fund owes more than it holds in this currency.
dashboard.toImputeHint: Transfers received that the fund cannot yet put a name to.
dashboard.unmeasurableBody: While a loan has no recorded schedule, « are the lenders covered » has no answer, and no distribution can be proposed.
dashboard.noMovementsBody: Import a statement from the treasury screen: everything else follows from it.
dashboard.nothingPendingBody: Every transfer received carries a name. This is the state that pile has to stay in.
dashboard.noProjectsBody: A project is what the fund deploys the money it received into.

treasury.title: Treasury
treasury.subtitle: The statement lines, what they probably are, and what a human declares them to be.
treasury.importHelp: A JSON list of lines. Replaying the same file duplicates nothing.
treasury.notJson: What you pasted is not valid JSON.
treasury.notAList: Expected a list of statement lines.
treasury.imported: {{count}} new line. Lines already known were skipped.
treasury.imported_other: {{count}} new lines. Lines already known were skipped.
treasury.label: Description
treasury.ruleProposesTitle: The rule suggests, it never decides
treasury.ruleProposesBody: Automatically attributing a 200,000 transfer to a name that looked close is not a saving of time.
treasury.thirdPartyWarning: The name does not match the holder: this is a third-party payment and needs a reason.
treasury.subscriptionHint: The commitment this transfer pays into.
treasury.imputedAmountHint: One transfer may cover several commitments.
treasury.thirdPartyReasonHint: Required when the payer is not the investor.
treasury.noCallsBody: A call asks an investor for part of what they committed. It is not money: the transfer arrives later, on a statement.

basis.payer_iban: Payer's account: identifies the person, not the call

treasury.camtHelp: Drop your bank's file here. The references it carries are exactly as the investor typed them, which is what makes the automatic matching work. Re-importing the same statement creates no duplicate.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Where the fund put the money, and what came back. Every figure is the attribution of a bank movement, never a keyed-in number.
projects.noneBody: A project is what the fund deploys its investors' money into.
projects.name: Name
projects.targetHint: An intention. What actually went in is the sum of the deployments.
projects.overReturnedTitle: A project returned more capital than it took
projects.overReturnedBody: This is deliberately not rounded to zero: it is either a data error or somebody else's money being repaid. Both deserve a look.

investors.title: Investor register
investors.subtitle: Who may place money here, and on the strength of which check.
investors.noneBody: The register is empty. An investor can exist with no online access: the record and the login are two separate things.
investors.blockedBody: Any verdict other than « accepted » stops every commitment and every payment in. A check that blocks nothing is theatre.
investors.ibanHint: Encrypted at rest. It also lets the fund recognise this investor's transfers.
investors.added: Investor added. Their file still has to be checked before any commitment.
investors.capacityHint: The threshold above which a risk warning must be acknowledged is the greater of 1,000 € and 5 % of this capacity. While it is undeclared the threshold stays unknown and every commitment is refused: an absent capacity is not an unlimited one.
investors.quotaTitle: {{current}} investor out of the {{limit}} your plan includes
investors.quotaTitle_other: {{current}} investors out of the {{limit}} your plan includes
investors.quotaNearBody: One place left. Beyond that, your plan does not allow further registrations.
investors.quotaNearBody_other: {{count}} places left. Beyond that, your plan does not allow further registrations.
investors.quotaOverageBody: Each investor beyond the plan is billed {{price}} €/month, added to your subscription. You will be asked before every registration.
investors.quotaBlockedBody: Your plan does not allow going past this ceiling. Move to a larger plan to register more investors.
investors.quotaUnknownTitle: Your allowance could not be read
investors.quotaUnknownBody: The subscription console did not answer. While it stays silent no investor can be registered: granting an allowance nobody checked would make every plan unlimited.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.subtitle: What an investor asked for, and what the fund agreed. Two separate facts, and only one of them binds.
subscriptions.noneBody: A request comes from the investor's portal. It binds nobody until the fund accepts it.
subscriptions.accepted: Request accepted: the commitment is created.
subscriptions.reasonRequired: A refusal with no reason can be neither reconsidered nor explained to the investor.
subscriptions.requestSent: Request sent. The fund will look at it alongside your file.
subscriptions.requestHelp: You are expressing an intent. It binds nobody, and nothing is taken.

distributions.title: Distributions
distributions.subtitle: The lender is served before the subscriber, and above all: nothing reaches a subscriber while the debt stands.
distributions.asOfHint: The date interest is computed to.
distributions.natureIncomeHelp: Capital stays at work: everything paid to subscribers is income.
distributions.natureCapitalHelp: Capital goes back to subscribers first, and whatever exceeds it is income.
distributions.unmeasurableTitle: A debt could not be measured
distributions.lendersCaption: Creditors. Served first, and pro rata among themselves when there is not enough.
distributions.membersCaption: Pro rata to the capital each of them actually has at work.
distributions.blockedWhy: This is not a queue: paying subscribers out of the cash owed on a loan's next instalment does not reorder a default, it causes one.
distributions.decideHelp: Recording marks the distribution as decided. The payment is still to be made: the investor is paid when the outgoing transfer is attached.
distributions.decided: Distribution recorded. It is decided, not yet paid.
distributions.noneBody: Nothing has been paid back to investors yet.

portfolio.title: My portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: What you hold, computed from what actually happened. Nothing is stored.
portfolio.noneBody: You have no commitment in the fund yet.
portfolio.contributedHint: What reached the fund's account and was tied to you.
portfolio.atWorkHint: What you paid in, less the capital already returned.
portfolio.receivedHint: Interest, preferred return or gain. Never your own capital.

calls.title: My capital calls
calls.subtitle: What the fund is asking you for, and the reference to quote on your transfer.
calls.noneBody: Nothing is being asked of you at the moment.
calls.referenceHelp: Quote this reference on the transfer: it is what lets the fund tie it to you without guessing.
calls.qrHelp: Scan this code with your banking app: beneficiary, account, amount and reference are already filled in.
calls.qrEuroOnly: The payment code exists in euro only. For this call, enter the account details by hand.

myDistributions.title: My payouts
myDistributions.subtitle: What the fund paid you, split between your own capital and what you earned.
myDistributions.noneBody: The fund has not paid you anything yet.
myDistributions.capitalHint: Your own money coming back. It is not a gain.

statement.title: Annual statement
statement.subtitle: What you were paid during the year, in the shape a tax return needs.
statement.yearHint: The year is the year of PAYMENT, never the year of the decision.
statement.noneBody: No payout reached you that year.
statement.decidedNotPaidBody: These amounts were decided during the year without leaving the fund's account. They are not part of your income: you did not receive them.
statement.capitalIsNotIncome: Capital repaid is not income: it is your own money coming back.

password.title: Change your password
password.forced: This password was handed to you by somebody else. Choose your own before going further.
password.optional: You can replace your password at any time.
password.mismatch: The two entries do not match.
password.whyCurrent: The current password is asked for even when the change is imposed: without it, a stolen token would be enough to take the account over for good.
password.newHint: At least ten characters. A short sentence is easier to remember than a complicated word.
password.confirmHint: The same one again, to rule out a typo.

kyc.title: Verification of {{name}}
kyc.reasonRequired: A refusal with no reason can be neither reconsidered nor explained to the investor.
kyc.blocksMoney: Until the verdict reads « accepted », this investor can neither commit nor pay anything in.

project.movementOut: The OUTGOING transfer that carried the money.
project.movementIn: The INCOMING transfer that brought it back.
project.splitRequired: The two amounts are asked for separately: a return keyed in as one figure lets a project that merely gave the money back be shown as performance.
project.valueHint: A valuation is a dated, signed judgement rather than a flow: it is imputed on no bank movement. It is recorded in your name and never edited; correcting one means recording another.

convert.title: Convert this loan
convert.explain: A loan becomes a subscription. It is an EVENT: the loan holding closes, a subscription holding opens, and both survive. The reverse does not exist.
convert.interestWarning: Accrued interest is a real amount: on a bullet loan it is every coupon since the drawdown. Leaving it implicit is how a lender silently loses a year of interest at conversion.

pay.title: Pay this distribution
pay.explain: The investor is paid when the outgoing transfer is attached, not when the decision is taken.

invest.title: Ask to subscribe
invest.explain: You are expressing an intent. It binds nobody and nothing is taken: the fund will look at it alongside your file, and its acceptance is what creates the commitment.
invest.documentHint: The version you had in front of you, recorded now: it cannot be recovered later.
invest.blocked: Your file has not been accepted yet: no subscription is possible until it is.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.message: You will have to enter your credentials again.
signOut.messageWithAccount: You will leave the session of {{email}} and have to enter your credentials again.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.subtitle: What you pay to use Le Comptoir Invest, and how you pay it.
billing.blockedHint: No payment has been recorded for this subscription. Paying below restores access.
billing.notManagedHint: This instance is not attached to any subscription console: there is nothing to pay from this screen.
billing.methodsHint: Card payment opens with our provider: no bank details ever pass through this product.
billing.noMethod: No payment method is open at the moment. Please get in touch to settle your subscription.
billing.byCardHint: Immediate payment and automatic renewal, cancellable at any time.
billing.declareMessage: You are reporting that you have sent the transfer for your subscription. This declaration is not a payment: it will be matched against the actual bank movement, and access is restored once the transfer is seen.
billing.changeMessage: Your subscription will move to {{plan}}, at {{price}} per month.
billing.prorationEstimate: Estimated prorated amount for the current period: {{amount}}.
billing.noInvoiceHint: Your subscription invoices will appear here from the first payment.
billing.invoiceUnavailable: This invoice could not be opened.
billing.actionRefused: The operation did not go through
billing.unavailable: The subscription service is momentarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
billing.noPaymentPage: The payment page could not be opened. Please try again shortly.
billing.noPortal: The management area could not be opened. Please try again shortly.
billing.paymentDoneHint: Thank you. Your subscription is up to date; the charge may take a moment to appear below.
billing.paymentCancelledHint: Nothing was charged. You can resume the payment whenever you like.

performance.title: Performance
performance.subtitle: What has come back, and what cannot yet be said about the rest.
performance.residualHint: What is still held, once valued. This product computes no valuation of its own.
performance.dpiHint: What has come back, over the capital paid in.
performance.tvpiHint: Distributed and residual, over the capital paid in. Needs a valuation.
performance.rvpiHint: Residual over the capital paid in. Needs a valuation.
performance.irrRealisedHint: Covers only what has already come back: it under-states a fund still open.
performance.nothingHint: No contribution has been recorded yet. Performance appears as soon as the first capital call is collected.

lateCalls.title: Late calls
lateCalls.subtitle: What is still short, and who is genuinely late.
lateCalls.noneHint: Every call due by that date has been settled.
lateCalls.unsentHint: These calls were never sent: it is the first notice that is missing, not a reminder. Chasing them would blame the investor for the fund's own omission.

funds.title: Investment vehicles
funds.subtitle: A vehicle is a fund: it holds projects, subscribers, its own terms and its own bank account.
funds.name: Name
funds.ibanHint: This fund's bank account. Without it, and with another vehicle in existence, the cash cannot be split between them and the net asset value cannot be totalled.
funds.noneHint: There is nothing to do here while you run only one. Everything you record belongs to that single fund, and the figures are computed for it. Opening a vehicle becomes necessary the day you run a second one.
funds.cashNotSeparable: No account of its own while another vehicle exists: its net asset value cannot be totalled.
funds.cannotTotal: The net asset value cannot be totalled
funds.noValue: No net asset value on that date
funds.noValueHint: Pick a vehicle and a date: the net asset value adds the projects to the cash, then deducts what the lenders are owed.

notice.title: The notice to send
notice.sendingNotSetUpHint: This product's sending address has not been set. It is entered in Le Comptoir Alice, « Systeme de communication » tab, « Invest » scope. It is never taken from another product: a capital call sent from a property-management tool's domain reads as a phishing attempt. Meanwhile, copy the text above into your own mail client; the call will not be recorded as notified, since the product will not have notified it.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Your account and your settings.
profile.accountKindHelp: Set by the console, depending on whether the account manages its own money or its clients' money.
profile.managedByConsole: These details are held by the administration console: they are changed there, so that the invoice and this screen cannot say two different things.

emailTheme.title: E-mail look
emailTheme.lead: The letters sent on behalf of your management company (capital calls, reminders, links to choose a password) wear the look chosen here.
emailTheme.productDefaultNamed: Today: {{name}}. It follows the console's setting.
emailTheme.productDefaultUnnamed: The look the console gives this product.
emailTheme.help: The list of looks is kept by the administration console. Your choice applies to the next letters sent.
emailTheme.unavailable: The console does not answer: the list could not be read. Your e-mails keep their current look.

guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: What each screen of Le Comptoir Invest does, and how to use it.
guide.help: Every field has a short help right under it: it says what the field expects.

dashboard.what: The fund's position by currency: cash, debt owed to lenders, what can be distributed, and money received that waits to be allocated.
dashboard.how: Start by importing a statement from the treasury: everything else follows. Tap a project or the pile of unidentified money to open it.

projects.what: The projects the fund deploys the money it received into, with what came back and their multiple.
projects.how: Create a project, deploy money by naming the outgoing transfer, record a return with capital and income apart, value it and change its status.

funds.what: The investment vehicles: each carries its projects, its subscribers, its terms and its bank account.
funds.how: Open a vehicle with its currency and its account, fill in its terms (preferred return, carried interest, management fee) and move its status from raising to closed.

distributions.what: How what the fund pays out is split: lenders first, then subscribers pro rata to their capital at work.
distributions.how: Enter the amount, the date and the nature, compute the waterfall, then record the decision. The distribution is paid when you attach the outgoing transfer to it.

performance.what: What came back to investors on a given date: capital paid in, already distributed, residual value and rate of return.
performance.how: Choose the valuation date. An incomplete measure says so, rather than showing a wrong figure.

treasury.what: The lines of the bank statement, what they probably are, and what you declare they are. Capital calls are issued here too.
treasury.how: Import the statement (CAMT.053). Allocate each incoming transfer to a subscription: the rule proposes, you decide. Issue a capital call to ask an investor for part of their commitment.

lateCalls.what: The capital calls overdue on a given date: what is missing, late interest and the reminder due.
lateCalls.how: Write the first notice or the reminder, review it in the investor's language, then send it.

investors.what: The investor register: who may invest here, on what verification, and in which category.
investors.how: Add an investor, a person or a company, with their bank details. Record the verification of their file and their eligibility: a file that is not accepted blocks any commitment.

subscriptions.what: The subscription requests from the investors' portal, and what the fund did with them.
subscriptions.how: Accept a request to create the commitment, or refuse it with a reason. An accepted loan can later be converted into a subscription.

portfolio.what: What you hold in the fund: committed, paid in, capital at work, income received and still to pay.
portfolio.how: Follow the status of your file. Once it is accepted, ask to subscribe: it is an intention, nothing is debited.

capitalCalls.what: What the fund asks you to pay in, with the reference to quote in your transfer.
capitalCalls.how: Quote the reference in the transfer's wording, or scan the code with your banking app for a prefilled transfer in euros.

myDistributions.what: What the fund paid back to you, split between your capital and what you earned.
myDistributions.how: Browse your payments, with your capital and your income counted apart.

statement.what: The yearly statement: what you were paid, in the shape a tax return needs.
statement.how: Choose the year and download the statement. Repaid capital is not income.

theProjects.what: The fund's projects, their status and what they returned.
theProjects.how: Look at the projects your money is invested in.

profile.what: Your account: e-mail address, role and workspace.
profile.how: Change your password and choose the look of the e-mails sent to your investors. The name and the address are changed in the administration console.

billing.what: The subscription to Le Comptoir Invest: the current plan, the payment methods and the invoices.
billing.how: Pay by card or direct debit, or declare a bank transfer. Change plan and download your invoices as PDF.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.headline: Your investors, looked after at the size of your round
pricing.lead: Subscriptions, capital calls, distributions and annual statements: one plan by number of investors, and one more investor at the stated price as your fund grows.
pricing.overage: Beyond that, {{amount}} per investor per month
pricing.forClients: Do you run several vehicles on behalf of clients?
pricing.none: The plans cannot be shown right now. Write to us at contact@lecomptoir.services.
pricing.fact1: Your account opens once your e-mail address is confirmed.
pricing.fact2: Your investors have their own access, included in the plan.
pricing.fact3: Change plan at any time from the « Subscription » screen.

signup.title: Create my account
signup.profileHint: A club or a fund picks a catalogue plan; a management company receives a quotation.
signup.planHint: Prices are per month, excluding tax.
signup.noPlan: No plan is shown: our team will handle your request.
signup.requesterKind: The account is opened in the name of
signup.requesterKindHint: The name the account and the invoices will bear.
signup.countryHint: The country where you are established.
signup.siretHint: The national register fills in the company name and address.
signup.numberHint: The number under which the company is registered in its country.
signup.firstNameHint: The first name you go by.
signup.emailHint: The confirmation link, then your access, will be sent there.
signup.phoneHint: To reach you about your account.
signup.addressHint: The address that will appear on your invoices.
signup.zipHint: Filled in when you pick an address.
signup.cityHint: Filled in when you pick an address.
signup.needHint: How many vehicles and investors, for a fair offer.
signup.badNumber: This SIREN or SIRET is not valid: check the digits.
signup.next: After sending: a confirmation e-mail; your click opens the account, then your access arrives by e-mail.
signup.quoteNext: Our team will reply with an offer suited to the number of vehicles you run.
signup.badEmail: This e-mail address is not valid: check it.
signup.emailHintQuote: Our answer and our offer will be sent there.

siretInput.invalid: Invalid number: the check digit does not match (9 digits for a SIREN, 14 for a SIRET).
siretInput.short_one: {{count}} digit typed: a SIREN has 9, a SIRET 14.
siretInput.short_other: {{count}} digits typed: a SIREN has 9, a SIRET 14.
siretInput.notFound: Number not found in the national register: check it, you can still go ahead.
siretInput.unreachable: The register is not answering: the number will be checked later.
